scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @auth-lab/database run build && pnpm --parallel --filter @auth-lab/web --filter @auth-lab/api run dev
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @auth-lab/database run build && pnpm --filter @auth-lab/web run build && pnpm --filter @auth-lab/api run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @auth-lab/database run typecheck && pnpm --filter @auth-lab/web run typecheck && pnpm --filter @auth-lab/api run typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @auth-lab/database run build && pnpm --filter @auth-lab/api run test && pnpm --filter @auth-lab/database run test
scripts.ci:verify: pnpm db:validate && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
